{"consolidated_memory":"## NaN Feature Encoder Issues in ml/features/encoder.py

Two separate incidents in the same corner of ml/features/encoder.py, both producing NaN values in output columns and reproduced by encoding batches holding sparse columns.

### Occasion 1: Race Condition on Composite Key [2026-01-28]
- **File:** ml/features/encoder.py
- **Signal:** NaN value in one output column
- **Trigger:** Occurred only when two requests raced on the same key
- **Root Cause:** Missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- **Fix:** Added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- **PR:** #5131 on branch fix/nan-feature-1
- **Outcome:** Reclaimed 32 GB of blob storage
- **Repro:** Encode the batch holding the sparse column

### Occasion 2: Floating Point Rounding in Money Path [2026-03-28]
- **File:** ml/features/encoder.py
- **Signal:** NaN value in one output column
- **Trigger:** Occurred only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units
- **PR:** #8934 on branch fix/nan-feature-2
- **Outcome:** Cold start dropped 13 percent, down to 593 ms
- **Repro:** Encode the batch holding the sparse column

Both were on the ml pipeline side and built on context from earlier NaN feature work in the same area."}
